fields.subject: Postgres Type Mapping
fields.trigger: the internal ColumnDefinition property of a model property's MapToPg*Attribute variant is evaluated
fields.response: render that column's definition as the double-quoted column name followed by the PostgreSQL type name selected by the variant, taken from one shared NpgsqlDbType-to-PostgreSQL type-name mapping (for example Double renders double precision, TimestampTz renders timestamp with time zone, TimeTz renders time with time zone, and InternalChar renders the double-quoted "char"), including the variant's declared length (Varchar when the length is positive, Char), precision and scale (Numeric), or, for Array, the element type's PostgreSQL type name followed by [] wherever its constructor requires one for those types — except MapToPgByteaAttribute, whose constructor-required Length configures only parameter and buffer construction and is never rendered into the bulk-load column definition, which stays the unparameterized "bytea"; a Varchar whose length is zero or negative renders the unbounded varchar
fields.postcondition: the rendered definition is valid PostgreSQL DDL naming the type the variant's NpgsqlDbType selects, carrying the variant's length, precision/scale, or element type name where that type renders one, but never carrying MapToPgByteaAttribute's Length and never a raw lower-cased NpgsqlDbType enum name such as double[] or internalchar[]
